description: Bounds of a saved composition of agents and pipelines (FU-244). The Worker refuses a violation at assembly with runtime_message; Main refuses it wherever a stack is composed, naming the attachment. max_version_bytes is the Worker's load budget, which Main cannot measure: an attachment past it is left out and named, and a root that cannot load its own composition ends with size_runtime_message. Both sides assert this file.
runtime_message: This agent or pipeline cannot run: its attachments form a circular reference, nest deeper than allowed, or include a pipeline that pauses where the pause cannot be continued. Review its attachments and change the one that breaks the rule.
size_runtime_message: This agent or pipeline cannot run: its attached agents and pipelines are too large to load together. Remove attachments or shorten their instructions.
